units.source_text: 本回紧接第五十一回《浮舟》，写薰大将二十七岁三月至二十八岁夏天期间所发生的事。

en.t: This chapter follows directly after Chapter 51, Ukifune, and describes events concerning General Kaoru from the third month of his twenty-seventh year through the summer of his twenty-eighth year.

units.source_text: 第五十二回《蜉蝣》亦紧接第五十一回，但单叙薰大将与匂亲王方面之事。

en.t: Chapter 52, Kagero, also follows directly after Chapter 51, but it recounts only matters concerning General Kaoru and Prince Nio.

units.source_text: 本回则叙另一方面的事。

en.t: This chapter, by contrast, tells of events on the other side.

units.source_text: 这里的“此时”是指浮舟失踪前数日。

en.t: The phrase at this time here refers to the several days before Ukifune disappeared.
